title: The Blood Pressure row's "Target <120/80 · Aug 2026" wraps to two lines at 375 and 390 when a previous value shows, against US-62 AC8a's one-line claim
evidence: Done 2026-11-14 (PR 1722, owner ruling (b)): the cause was the name column's width, not the previous value. In real WebKit (iPhone 13 profile, Pages dev build) "Target <120/80 · Aug 2026" is 151.6px and "Target <130/80 · May 2026" (65 and over) 153.1px at 12px; the name column is 147px at 375 and 150px at 390, so the line wrapped with one reading or two, and "2026" broke off alone. Fit by pixels was refused as fragile; instead the month and year are one nowrap span (.md-row-date, MyDataRows.tsx), so a wrap falls only at the "·" and the date moves whole to the next line. Words, tracks and the engine are unchanged. The value column's own overflow is H108. Was: Found on main (9ac060dca) in PR 1710 (H83), real WebKit, iPhone 13 profile, SI, a man of 51 at 178 cm with two pressures (126/80 after 132/84). The meta line breaks after "Aug", leaving "2026" on its own line; the Range line count is 2 at both 375 and 390, in SI and US units. US-62 AC8a says the trend stays 44 wide below 390px so "Target <120/80 · Aug 2026" keeps one line at 375px; the bracketed previous "(132/84)" widens the reading column. Shots: h83-rows-si-375-bp.png and h83-rows-si-390-bp.png (and the us ones), listed in PR 1710's body. (H104)
